findings.finding: Canonical V14 can accept an arbitrary/empty reentry payload, report trace OK, and treat REENTERED as recovery COMPLETE without an explicit terminal DONE receipt or exact causal support binding.

The simpler candidate-only V17 lane passed an accepted target-VPS differential for exact attempt/outcome binding, terminal DONE, typed no-learning, restart-before-DONE recovery, duplicate rejection and rollback. This is candidate evidence only and does not establish closed causal provenance.

Accepted target-VPS run 31408220117 confirmed that the earlier/simple V17 candidate accepted fabricated episode/signal/causal/delta identifiers, reported DONE_VALID/COMPLETE, and accepted terminal DONE while V15 presence remained IDLE epoch 0 and V16 execution context remained unbound.

Accepted target-VPS run 31408872635 confirmed that the richer FK-backed V17 could still cross-splice individually valid but causally unrelated rows: an unverified unrelated prediction outcome, CORRELATED_ONLY credit, unrelated CURRENT semantic record and a free snapshot hash could reach terminal DONE while SQLite integrity/FK checks stayed clean. Referential integrity is not causal integrity.

Additive candidate V17.1 introduces explicit causal-support, semantic-delta-admission and reentry-authority receipts; binds the same provider receipt across verified effect and prediction outcomes; requires same GWT cycle and actual receiver use/local effect; excludes CORRELATED_ONLY; fences terminalization to the same current execution/lease epoch. A target-VPS workflow is committed, but no persisted V17.1 receipt was observed at this delta refresh.

U10 architecture requires execution_id/lease_epoch fencing and provenance-bound reentry, but U10_EPOCH_VERSIONED_STATE_CANDIDATE.sql currently leaves u10_tx_commits.execution_id/lease_epoch nullable and models u10_reentry_receipts episode/signal/causal/outcome/credit/delta references as unconstrained TEXT. U10 therefore does not yet enforce its own causal/execution invariants at the storage boundary.

Existing accepted-Hostinger mechanism evidence favors logical unification plus epoch-guarded derived projections: single-file paired commit p50 was lower, while guarded split-file steady reads were near parity; unguarded split snapshots were incoherent. This does not justify physical graph/vector/tensor consolidation yet.

The accepted target VPS currently reports SQLite 3.45.1 with WAL. The fail-closed WAL-reset guard classifies this upstream version in the documented affected range and sets release_gate=BLOCK_AFFECTED_SQLITE_WAL_RESET_RANGE. A disposable 2-second race canary observed no corruption, but by contract absence of observed corruption cannot prove safety. Release requires an upgraded/fixed SQLite build, verified distro backport, or a separately machine-checked topology exclusion before WAL can be release authority.

architecture_delta.selected_direction: One authoritative epoch-versioned semantic transaction/causal-history plane with exact execution fencing; current heads as derived projections; ClayGraph/vector/tensor as rebuildable epoch-bound projections unless target evidence later proves physical colocation superior.
required_u10_changes_before_promotion: Make semantic state append-only/versioned by state_epoch with exact replay and current-head derivation; fix the current repeated-supersede history failure.
Make execution binding explicit and fail-closed for authoritative execution/effect commits: exact current execution_id plus V15/V16 lease_epoch fence, with stale/zombie writer rejection.

Replace free-form reentry support symbols and mere FK existence with one explicit causal-admission authority relation joining verified provider outcome, same-cycle GWT causal use, non-correlated causal credit, admitted semantic delta/state epoch and current execution epoch.
Make terminal DONE a distinct durable semantic receipt whose validity depends on the exact verified effect attempt/outcome, exact causal-admission/reentry binding and still-current execution epoch.
Keep ClayGraph/vector/tensor derived/rebuildable with explicit projection_source_epoch/readiness and fail-closed critical reads while physical colocation remains benchmark-gated.
Resolve SQLite WAL-reset 2026 runtime safety before any SQLite/WAL release claim: fixed/upgraded runtime, verified vendor backport, or independently proven safe topology.
Keep all V17/V17.1/U10 changes additive and candidate-only until exact-source target-VPS crash/restart/concurrency/recovery/resource gates pass.
do_not_promote: Do not infer causal provenance from non-empty identifiers or foreign-key existence alone.
Do not infer current self.root ownership merely because a verified provider outcome exists.
Do not treat integrity_check/foreign_key_check as proof of causal closure.
Do not merge ClayGraph/vector/tensor physical storage merely to remove an epoch guard that is already cheap in steady reads.
Do not treat a clean bounded WAL race canary as evidence that an upstream-affected SQLite build is release-safe.

next_falsifier: On the accepted Ubuntu VPS, V17.1 must reject fabricated/cross-spliced GWT-credit-delta support and stale/unbound execution terminalization while accepting one fully closed exact provider-outcome -> same-cycle GWT use -> verified causal credit -> admitted state-epoch delta -> reentry-authority -> DONE chain, then survive crash/restart and exact replay; independently resolve the SQLite WAL runtime release gate.
research_consequence: NO U10/V17/V17.1 promotion claim. F-V01-04 remains OPEN. The persistent Clay state now records accepted-target negative evidence, candidate refinement, the SQLite runtime release blocker and the exact next falsifiers.
